subject: Event-driven local worktree cleanup investigation
result: Removed the clean merged context-pressure worktree through the existing local prune command as a real acceptance case. Existing build-hygiene script is manual, only recognizes ancestry merges, and fails outside repo. A repository cannot observe GitHub PR merge events locally; CI cannot remove local /private/tmp paths. Need the creator/finisher integration point for these external worktrees before implementing a reliable event-driven trigger. AIKit task close only manages .aikit/tasks worktrees, not the observed /private/tmp worktrees.
